set(NMO_DEPS_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

set(NMO_MINIZ_DIR "${NMO_DEPS_ROOT}/miniz")
if(EXISTS "${NMO_MINIZ_DIR}/miniz.h")
    message(STATUS "Using bundled miniz from: ${NMO_MINIZ_DIR}")
    if(NOT TARGET miniz)
        add_subdirectory("${NMO_MINIZ_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/miniz" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    endif()
    if(TARGET miniz)
        if(MSVC)
            target_compile_options(miniz PRIVATE /w)
        else()
            target_compile_options(miniz PRIVATE -w)
        endif()
    endif()
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled miniz not found at ${NMO_MINIZ_DIR}")
endif()

set(NMO_YYJSON_DIR "${NMO_DEPS_ROOT}/yyjson")
if(EXISTS "${NMO_YYJSON_DIR}/src/yyjson.h")
    message(STATUS "Using bundled yyjson from: ${NMO_YYJSON_DIR}")
    if(NOT TARGET yyjson)
        set(YYJSON_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(YYJSON_BUILD_DOC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(YYJSON_BUILD_MISC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        add_subdirectory("${NMO_YYJSON_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/yyjson" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    endif()
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled yyjson not found at ${NMO_YYJSON_DIR}")
endif()

set(NMO_LUA_DIR "${NMO_DEPS_ROOT}/lua")
if(EXISTS "${NMO_LUA_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(STATUS "Using bundled Lua from: ${NMO_LUA_DIR}")
    if(NOT TARGET lua::lua)
        set(LUA_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(LUA_BUILD_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(LUA_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(LUA_BUILD_READLINE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(LUA_BUILD_LIBEDIT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        add_subdirectory("${NMO_LUA_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lua" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    endif()

    if(TARGET liblua_objects)
        if(MSVC)
            target_compile_options(liblua_objects PRIVATE /w)
        else()
            target_compile_options(liblua_objects PRIVATE -w)
        endif()
    endif()

    if(NOT TARGET lua::lua)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Bundled Lua at ${NMO_LUA_DIR} did not export the expected lua::lua target")
    endif()
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled Lua not found at ${NMO_LUA_DIR}")
endif()

set(NMO_MINIZ_DIR "${NMO_MINIZ_DIR}" PARENT_SCOPE)
set(NMO_YYJSON_DIR "${NMO_YYJSON_DIR}" PARENT_SCOPE)
set(NMO_LUA_DIR "${NMO_LUA_DIR}" PARENT_SCOPE)
